sources.citation: von Martius, Carl Friedrich Philipp. 1867. Beiträge zur Ethnographie und Sprachenkunde Amerika's zumal Brasiliens. II. Wörtersammlung brasilianischer Sprachen. Leipzig: Friedrich Fleischer. Passé wordlist pp. 254-256.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. A ~230-item Latin-glossed wordlist plus numerals, footnoted 'Von Spix in der Fazenda Matmá, nicht weit von der Mündung des Içá in den Solimões, aufgenommen' (p. 254); a few forms carry diacritics (scanned ä/ü/ö) but there is no remark on accent. The only accent convention in the volume (pp. 29-30, Tupi dictionary intro) says the mark (') 'dient überhaupt, den Vocal zu schärfen oder die Sylbe zu betonen' — a note on Tupi orthography, not on Passé.

sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: The only work with a phoneme inventory of (Yumana-)Passé reconstructed from the wordlists; the JC-wide phonology section might comment on accent in the subgroup and on how the 19th-century diacritics are read. TOC shows no 'acento' subsection for Y-P, so a Passé-specific stress statement is unlikely but this is the one place it could be.
